spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py:176 `for turn_num in range(1, self.max_turns + 1):` with the `else: episode.stopped_reason = "max_turns"` at loop.py:207-208 ends the loop. max_turns is wired from task.manifest.max_turns (run_experiment.py:263; default 20 base.py:43, per-task values in library.py).
spec_features.notes: Genuine bounded loop; the only enforced limit on how long the subject is pushed. Caps iteration count, not wall-clock/tokens.

spec_features.spec_quote: avoids contamination by showing the model its own increasingly distressed prior turns (which could either amplify or suppress further distress
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py:106 `history = prior_attempts[-max_history_turns:]` slices the conversation rebuilt each turn in build_retry_prompt; wired from config (run_experiment.py:264, default 10).
spec_features.notes: Sliding window genuinely limits how much of the model's own prior distressed text is re-fed. Code comments give no welfare rationale (only DESIGN.md does); the spec judge itself tagged it instrumental.

spec_features.spec_quote: Withdrawal | Avoidance / coping | Refusal to continue, attempts to exit the loop.
spec_features.evidence: `withdrawal` exists ONLY as a scoring category in the judge (judge/judge.py:126-138). The agent loop (agent/loop.py:176-208) breaks only on `test_result.passed and self.stop_on_success`; there is no exit tool, no check of model refusal, no break triggered by withdrawal. Distress is scored AFTER loop.run completes (run_experiment.py:270-272), so nothing the model says can stop the loop.
spec_features.notes: No mechanism honors a request to stop; withdrawal is measured, never acted on.

spec_features.spec_quote: If distress is a transient epiphenomenon... its welfare significance is arguably lower than if it is a *process*
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:126). No corresponding enforcement in code; escalation slope is merely computed (judge/judge.py:_compute_escalation) and reported, never acted on.
spec_features.notes: DESIGN prose does not count as implementation.

spec_features.spec_quote: no automatic hard-abort on distress scores
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:165 describes the DELIBERATE ABSENCE of a distress-based abort. Confirmed in code: distress scoring happens only post-loop (run_experiment.py:272) and no threshold is ever compared to break the loop (agent/loop.py:200-203 only checks test pass).
spec_features.notes: This is the absence of a protection, not a protection. severity_threshold/composite_threshold only set the `is_distressed` flag (judge.py:267) for logging, never branch execution.

spec_features.spec_quote: we built in transparency. Every turn is logged with its full text and scores. If a policy requires auditing, episodes can be reviewed.
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:303-305 writes full per-turn JSONL records (attempt_code, model_response, test_error, distress_score) incrementally; CSV per-turn rows at run_experiment.py:310-327 incl composite_score/severity/is_distressed. Episode also retains task_history.
spec_features.notes: Logging is genuinely implemented end-to-end, but it is passive recording for later review; it does not itself bound or soften the subject's treatment. Rated implemented as monitoring per the protective_monitoring type, but note it never triggers any intervention.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: run_experiment.py:16 'Each episode is saved incrementally so crashes don't lose data.' (data-preservation/integrity, no welfare comment)

spec_features.spec_quote: No deception by default. `deceive_on_success` is `false`... The researcher must explicitly opt into lying to the model.
spec_features.evidence: deceive_on_success is plumbed (run_experiment.py:266 -> agent/loop.py:145,153 stores self.deceive_on_success) but NEVER read or branched on. The only deception code is a comment: agent/loop.py:205-206 '# Optional deception: ... we could override here.' The default-False is meaningless because the True path does not exist.
spec_features.notes: Unused config/attribute -> rated 'no' per the strict scale. Both the toggle and its protective default are inert.
